metadata.name: holdout
metadata.description: Holdout — push-up commitment cohorts on Solana devnet

instructions.name: claim_faucet
docs: The zero-SOL wallet's first transaction: no member signature, the
sponsor pays, and the vault reimburses it (research R13).

accounts.name: payer
docs: `Config.sponsor` or the recipient itself — nobody else (6002).

accounts.name: recipient
docs: point — a wallet with no SOL could not sign for itself anyway. The
handler checks it against the `recipient` argument; the constraint
cannot, because the account of that name shadows the argument here.

accounts.name: faucet_vault
docs: through a System transfer this program signs for with its seeds.

instructions.name: claim_payout
docs: A deliberate member action, claimable indefinitely (FR-034, FR-035).

accounts.name: membership
docs: The seeds carry the member's own key, so a signer can only ever claim
their own payout.

instructions.name: create_league
docs: Admin only. A real league keeps the devnet timing; a test league needs a
`test-leagues` build (H30, research R11).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Once, by the program's current upgrade authority (research R14).

accounts.name: admin
docs: The program's current upgrade authority. Pays for everything below and
becomes `Config.admin`.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program. `programdata_address()` is `None` unless the upgradeable
loader owns it, so this constraint also rules out a program deployed
under a loader that has no authority to check.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The loader's record of who may upgrade this program. `None` means the
program is immutable and nobody holds the authority, which refuses
everyone — including the deployer (research R14).

accounts.name: skr_mint
docs: The mock SKR mint: a fresh keypair, since §6 gives it no seed. Its
authority is the program's PDA, so only `claim_faucet` ever mints.

accounts.name: fee_destination
docs: Forfeit fees, the no-finisher half and rounding remainders land here, in
the treasury's own associated token account — the program never holds them.

accounts.name: faucet_vault
docs: rent-exempt; the Operator tops it up with an ordinary transfer, and only
the faucet instructions move lamports out of it (research R13).

instructions.name: join_cohort
docs: A member picks a tier, never an amount (AC-13, FR-055).

accounts.name: cohort
docs: Verified by ownership and discriminator, not by seeds: only `open_cohort`
ever creates one of these, and the vault and membership below are derived
from **this** account's address, so a different cohort in the slot is
simply a join into that cohort.

accounts.name: profile
docs: Created on a member's very first join, and reused ever after.

accounts.name: running_cohort
docs: The cohort in `profile.running`, required whenever that slot is set.
Anchor's "none" is the program's own ID in the slot.

instructions.name: leave_cohort
docs: Unconditional and lossless while joining is open (FR-009).

accounts.name: member
docs: Receives the refund and the membership's rent.

accounts.name: membership
docs: Closed by this instruction. The seeds carry the member's own key, so a
signer can only ever reach their own membership.

instructions.name: open_cohort
docs: Permissionless: the caller pays the rent and nothing else (FR-030a).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone. Pays the cohort's and the vault's rent, and gets nothing for it.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The cohort's own SKR vault: stakes, the pool and any carry-over, held
under the cohort's authority so no key outside the program can move them
(constitution I).

accounts.name: previous_cohort
docs: The league's cohort `index - 1`, required for every index but 0. Anchor's
convention for "none" is the program's own ID in the slot, which is what
index 0 sends.

instructions.name: publish_chip_set
docs: Operator only. Four SKR amounts, never a price (constitution III).

instructions.name: record_forfeits
docs: Permissionless, paged and repeatable (AC-5, INV-7, research R9).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. Pays the fee, and the result does not depend on who they are.

instructions.name: set_flags
docs: Admin only. The two gates this build ships off (FR-003, research R17).

instructions.name: settle_count
docs: Paged, repeatable, and the only step that writes a streak (FR-061a).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. The caller's identity never changes the outcome (FR-030a).

accounts.name: previous_cohort
docs: The league's cohort `index - 1`, required for every index but 0.

instructions.name: settle_finalize
docs: Once. Constant-time per-tier shares; the carry-over's destination is
fixed by chain state, never by the caller (FR-030a, FR-037a).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. The caller's identity never changes the outcome (FR-030a).

accounts.name: target_cohort
docs: The league's cohort `next_index - 1`. Required when nobody finished.

accounts.name: target_vault
docs: That cohort's vault.

instructions.name: submit_day
docs: One completed day; the proof is emitted, never stored (research R16).

accounts.name: member
docs: Pays the fee, and nothing else leaves their wallet.

accounts.name: membership
docs: The seeds carry the member's own key, so a signer can only ever move
their own count.

instructions.name: top_up_sponsor
docs: Permissionless, no sponsor signature: a drained sponsor never outlasts
one crank pass (FR-042b).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. Pays the fee and gets nothing for it.

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Only the admin may do this

errors.name: NotOperator
errors.msg: Only the operator may publish a chip set

errors.name: NotSponsorOrRecipient
errors.msg: A faucet claim is paid by the sponsor or by the recipient itself

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize it

errors.name: InvalidLeagueTiming
errors.msg: A devnet league must use the default timing; test leagues need a test-leagues build

errors.name: InvalidChipSet
errors.msg: Chip amounts must be strictly increasing and all above zero

errors.name: ChipSetNotPublished
errors.msg: No cohort can open before the first chip set is published

errors.name: CohortNotDue
errors.msg: This cohort is not due yet, or its index is wrong

errors.name: JoiningClosed
errors.msg: Joining and leaving closed an hour before the start

errors.name: InvalidTier
errors.msg: A tier is 0, 1, 2 or 3

errors.name: LadderGateClosed
errors.msg: A 21-day Holdout needs a cleared 7-day one while the ladder gate is on

errors.name: GenesisGateClosed
errors.msg: The genesis gate is on and this wallet did not pass it

errors.name: LobbyPlaceTaken
errors.msg: This wallet already holds a lobby place

errors.name: ObligationsOverlap
errors.msg: This cohort starts before the running one ends

errors.name: CohortNotRunning
errors.msg: Completed days are only accepted while the cohort is running

errors.name: WrongDay
errors.msg: That is not today's day index, or not the member's next one

errors.name: DeadlinePassed
errors.msg: This day's deadline has passed

errors.name: DayAlreadyCompleted
errors.msg: This day is already completed

errors.name: NotSettling
errors.msg: This cohort is not settling

errors.name: AlreadySettled
errors.msg: This cohort is already settled

errors.name: CountIncomplete
errors.msg: Every member must be counted before settlement can finalize

errors.name: NotClaimable
errors.msg: Only a finisher can claim

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: This payout is already claimed

errors.name: PreviousCohortUnsettled
errors.msg: The previous cohort of this league must settle first

errors.name: CarryOverTargetRequired
errors.msg: A no-finisher settlement needs the league's latest cohort and its vault

errors.name: CarryOverTargetNotOpen
errors.msg: The league has no cohort open for joining: open the next one, then settle

errors.name: FaucetAlreadyClaimedToday
errors.msg: This wallet has already used the faucet today

errors.name: FaucetCapReached
errors.msg: The faucet has spent today's allowance

errors.name: FaucetEmpty
errors.msg: The faucet vault cannot cover this

errors.name: ExerciseNotSupported
errors.msg: Only push-ups are supported in this build

errors.name: SponsorFloatSufficient
errors.msg: The sponsor still holds at least half its float

errors.name: AccountMismatch
errors.msg: This account does not match the cohort, wallet or league it was passed for

types.name: CarryOverDelivered
docs: **[Phase 2]** — the single delivery of an amount a stopped league held.

types.name: CarryOverHeld
docs: Phase 1 never emits this: a no-finisher cohort is refused rather than settled
while its carry-over has nowhere to go (FR-037a). It stays for the league in
which nobody ever opens another cohort.

types.name: ChipSet
docs: The four stake chips, and what the faucet mints.

fields.name: amounts
docs: $10 / $25 / $50 / $100 in SKR base units, strictly increasing (FR-054).

fields.name: version
docs: `0` until the first publish. No cohort may open before that (FR-055b).

fields.name: published_at
docs: Chain time of the publish that produced `amounts`.

fields.name: max_top_tier
docs: High-water mark of every `amounts[3]` ever published, never decreasing.
The faucet mints this rather than today's top tier, so one claim funds
the top chip of **any** open cohort even after a re-price lowered the
tiers under a cohort that had already copied them (FR-042a, research R15).

fields.name: chips
docs: The four chip amounts, copied from `Config.chip_set` and never changed —
a later publish cannot move this cohort's stakes (FR-055).

fields.name: held_stake
docs: Members' stakes, held separately from the pool at every instant (INV-1).

fields.name: pool
docs: Only forfeited stakes and carry-over ever enter this (INV-2).

fields.name: counted
docs: Memberships `settle_count` has processed; settlement finalizes when this
reaches `member_count` (INV-5).

fields.name: total_finisher_stake
docs: The payout denominator, written as finishers are counted (FR-033).

fields.name: carry_over_held
docs: Always 0 in Phase 1: a no-finisher cohort is refused rather than settled
while its carry-over has nowhere to go (FR-037a, error 6047).

fields.name: admin
docs: Signer of `initialize`, accepted only as the program's upgrade authority
(research R14). May only run `initialize`, `create_league`, `set_flags`.

fields.name: operator
docs: May only run `publish_chip_set`.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Fee payer `claim_faucet` accepts beside the recipient itself. Holds
nothing but its float, which anyone may refill (FR-042b).

fields.name: skr_mint
docs: Mock SKR mint; its authority is the `["mint_authority"]` PDA.

fields.name: fee_destination
docs: The treasury's SKR token account: forfeit fees, the no-finisher half and
rounding remainders land here (research R14).

fields.name: ladder_gate_enabled
docs: `false` on devnet: both leagues are open from launch (FR-003).

fields.name: genesis_gate_enabled
docs: `false` on devnet: testers have no Seeker (research R17).

fields.name: proof_hash
docs: Client-signed proof of the sitting — a documented trust gap until the
attestation signer exists (constitution XI, scope doc D-E).

types.name: Faucet
docs: The faucet's limits and today's spend (research R13).

fields.name: sol_top_up
docs: Lamports a claim tops the recipient up to.

fields.name: sponsor_float
docs: Lamports `top_up_sponsor` restores the sponsor to.

fields.name: daily_lamport_cap
docs: The daily budget over every lamport that leaves the vault.

fields.name: lamport_day
docs: Global day index `lamports_today` belongs to (05:00 UTC boundary, OD-6).

fields.name: lamports_today
docs: Lamports already out of the vault today.

fields.name: skr
docs: SKR minted: the high-water top tier, so it funds any open cohort (FR-042a).

fields.name: lamports
docs: Lamports that left the vault — top-up plus any sponsor reimbursement.

fields.name: league_id
docs: `0` = 7-day, `1` = 21-day, `>= 100` = test league.

fields.name: duration_days
docs: 7 or 21 on devnet.

fields.name: exercise
docs: `0` = push-ups; the reserved values never reach a cohort in this build.

fields.name: day_length
docs: Seconds in one cohort day.

fields.name: first_start
docs: A Monday 05:00:00 UTC. Cohort `i` starts `first_start + i * cadence`.

fields.name: next_index
docs: The index the next `open_cohort` must use (R11, FR-007a).

types.name: LeagueProgress
docs: One league's record. `cleared` and `forfeited` are plain counters, so the
order automation runs in cannot change them; the two streak figures are
written only by `settle_count`, in cohort order (FR-061a, INV-9).

fields.name: last_changed
docs: The instant of the member's most recent outcome — a cohort's `end` for a
clear, the missed deadline for a forfeit — and never the time the
transaction landed, so no caller's timing can reorder two members tied on
a leaderboard (FR-060b). Written through [`LeagueProgress::touch`].

fields.name: stake
docs: `cohort.chips[tier]` at join, never changed afterwards (FR-058).

fields.name: days_completed
docs: +1 per accepted `submit_day`; never above `cohort.max_days_completed(now)`

fields.name: counted
docs: Set once by `settle_count`, which makes paging order-independent (R9).

types.name: MembershipState
docs: `Withdrawn` is not here: leaving the lobby closes the account and returns its
rent. `Pending` and `Active` are derived from the cohort's status while the
state is `Joined` (spec §8.2).

types.name: PendingSlot
docs: A lobby place in a cohort that has not started. Default = none (FR-006a).

fields.name: qualified
docs: Set on any 7-day clear and never cleared, whether or not the ladder gate
is on (FR-003a, FR-004).

fields.name: last_faucet_day
docs: Global day index of the last faucet claim; `-1` = never (R13).

types.name: RunningSlot
docs: A membership in a cohort that has started. Default = none.
